title: Concept: Lockfile records an optional dependency that fetches at install time
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry marked optional, which npm may fetch from the network during install, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Optional packages still execute install scripts when they resolve, so a failed or substituted fetch can add code paths the review never listed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Optional packages still execute install scripts when they resolve, so a failed or substituted fetch can add code paths the review never listed.
